Notes.Text:
This update for nmap fixes the following issue

- CVE-2026-58058: crafted IPv6 response with a truncated extension header can trigger out-of-bounds reads and a crash (bsc#1269570).

Vulnerabilities.Description: Nmap through 7.99 does not keep the IPv6 extension-header walk within the captured packet in ipv6_get_data_primitive (libnetutil/netutil.cc), so the pointer advances past the buffer and the remaining-length computation underflows to a large value. A scanned target or on-path attacker returning a crafted IPv6 response with a truncated extension header can trigger out-of-bounds reads and a crash during raw IPv6 scans.
